dtparam=audio=on
dtparam=krnbt=on
dtparam=uart1=on

# CPU
arm_boost=1

[all]
start_x=1
enable_uart=1
uart_2ndstage=1
arm_64bit=1
enable_gic=1
kernel=u-boot.bin
armstub=bl31.bin
camera_auto_detect=1

dtoverlay=dwc2
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d

max_framebuffers=2

# Automatically load overlays for detected DSI displays
display_auto_detect=1

dtoverlay=cma,cma-512
dtoverlay=rpivid-v4l2

menucmd=bootmenu
bootmenu_0=Lockdown Mode=setenv bootargs ${bootargs} androidboot.bliss.bootmode=lockdown
bootmenu_1=Admin Mode=setenv bootargs ${bootargs} androidboot.bliss.bootmode=admin
bootmenu_2=Reboot=reset
bootmenu_3=External SD card=run sdboot
bootmenu_4=Attached kernel=run attachboot
bootmenu_5=U-Boot boot order=boot
bootmenu_delay=20
saveenv
